title: Lung Cancer and Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis : Pathological and Molecular Characterization
brief_summary: Retrospective inclusion of lung cancers developed in a context of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, diagnosed and / or treated in participating centers. The cases are recovered retrospectively from the records of the pulmonology and pathology departments of our various partners.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Lung carcinoma
* Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis

Exclusion Criteria:

\- No tumor sample available
